name: mstack-plan
description: Turn an approved spec into a reviewed implementation plan: phases and tasks sized for one agent session each, red-green test steps, dependencies and parallel rounds, the best installed skills named per task (with vetted online suggestions for gaps), a review of every plan by the reviewers mstack-vendors offers (or its fallback review), a shared progress file, and an execute-plan.md that starts inline or multi-agent execution. One skill for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an approved spec into a reviewed, test-first plan.
interface.longDescription: Grounds the plan in the spec, the repository's docs and any external sources the user names, settles planning decisions in numbered question rounds, and splits the work into phases and red-green tasks that each fit one agent session. Names the best installed skills for every task, suggests vetted skills for gaps, has the reviewers mstack-vendors offers review the plan (or its fallback review), and writes a progress file and an execute-plan.md for inline or multi-agent execution.
